description: This file implements a bulk client for Elasticsearch, managing bulk requests with features like request thresholds, periodic flushing, and graceful shutdown.

classes.name: ReqBulkClient
classes.description: A client for managing bulk requests to Elasticsearch with support for thresholds and periodic flushing.

methods.name: NewReqBulkClient
methods.description: Constructor for ReqBulkClient, initializes the client with settings and starts periodic flushing if configured.

methods.name: IndexOp
methods.description: Adds an index operation to the bulk request, flushing if necessary.

methods.name: DeleteOp
methods.description: Adds a delete operation to the bulk request, flushing if necessary.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the bulk client, flushing remaining requests and stopping the periodic flusher.

methods.name: periodicFlusher
methods.description: Background goroutine that periodically flushes the bulk requests based on interval.

methods.name: _flush
methods.description: Performs the actual flush of pending requests, called with mutex lock.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Public method to flush pending requests.
